item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. This is the scale of transformation we expect—and we must prepare for it now.

2. Our position is clear: if we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, the global economy will at least double in size within the following decade. We must make that extraordinary growth work for everyone.

3. We expect superintelligent AI to transform the world economy. If it is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years. We must prepare for that future, not wait for it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We see this as a defining economic transformation, with enormous consequences for how we work, produce, and share prosperity. We must prepare now for an economy that grows at a fundamentally different pace. That means taking both the opportunities and the responsibilities seriously: building institutions that can keep up, helping people navigate change, and ensuring that greater output translates into better lives. We are committed to making this future one of broadly shared prosperity, not simply bigger numbers.
